tara (eng-platform): quick thread: propose a tiny, stable header set so SDKs + console show consistent error copy during rollouts: `X-RW-Err-Bucket`, `X-RW-Err-Code`, optional `X-RW-Err-Hint`.
omar (eng-runtime): 👍 keep buckets low-cardinality: quota/backpressure/validation/auth. we should not add new HTTP codes. 429/503/400/401 stay.
violet (prod-ux): need canonical one-liners per bucket+code and a console preview for tenant admins. also a short action suggestion shown in SDKs.
pete (eng-infra): telemetry: index `err_bucket` and `err_code` as tags, sample `err_hint`. enforce registry for codes to avoid drift. sanitize hint values before any logs.
tara (eng-platform): example mapping in RFC: bucket=quota, code=soft_limit -> UX: "You're close to quota. Try reducing concurrency or batching."
omar (eng-runtime): header example:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RW-Err-Bucket: quota
X-RW-Err-Code: soft_limit
X-RW-Err-Hint: retry-after=6;reduce_batch=true
harry (docs): I'll create a `msg_id` registry too so console pulls canonical localized text by id rather than embedding long messages in headers.
violet (prod-ux): rollout UX: admin toggle to preview messages per-tenant; simulator to replay failures and show console + SDK views.
pete (eng-infra): will add dashboard widget: stacked `err_bucket` with drilldown to `err_code`. sample human message ids for debugging only.
tara (eng-platform): open question: should SDKs auto-apply hints? my vote: expose hints and one-line suggestion, but do not auto-retry. reviewers: @omar @violet @pete
